Subject: MAP: Vendor onboarding & Coupa setup (Horizon Logistics)

Hi Karen - great speaking earlier. Per our call, attaching a short Mutual Action Plan (draft) that outlines the vendor onboarding milestone and the procurement dependencies so we can hit the targeted in-contract date. Key items for your procurement team:

- Milestone: Vendor onboarding / Coupa (or Ariba) supplier creation
  - Responsibility: Horizon Logistics procurement (primary) / Redwood (support)
  - Dependencies: Completed vendor form, signed W-9, banking details for ACH setup
  - Target close date for onboarding: 2026-04-12

- Milestone: PO/Contract issuance
  - Responsibility: Horizon Legal & Procurement / Redwood Sales
  - Dependencies: Supplier record created in Coupa, contract redlines resolved
  - Target close date: 2026-04-20

Action items for this thread:
1) Can you confirm whether Horizon will use Coupa or Ariba for supplier setup?
2) If Coupa, please share the supplier creation link/ID when available; if Ariba, share the specific onboarding steps.
3) We'll upload our vendor form and a filled W-9 into your secure portal - is there a preferred secure upload route?

I've looped in Marissa from Sales Ops for contract questions and Camila for post-sale onboarding. Dev from Finance is on standby for banking/ACH setup (cc).

Thanks - I'll follow up early next week if I don't hear back.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Rafael - good recap. We use Coupa for suppliers. A couple quick notes from procurement:

- We require a completed vendor form, a signed W-9, and either an ACH authorization letter or bank letter for verification.
- Preferred upload: secure portal link (I can generate a one-time upload link).
- Once the supplier record is created in Coupa, we'll need a supplier ID to route the PO.

I'll confirm the Coupa contact and can open the supplier request tomorrow. Targeting the supplier creation by 2026-04-08 on our side, then PO the following week if there are no redlines.

Can you attach the W-9 and a completed vendor form to this thread? Also loop in Finance for banking questions.

Hi Karen - Dev from Redwood Finance here. Quick checklist to speed ACH/vendor setup:

1) Bank letter on bank letterhead OR a voided check (PDF) showing account name and routing/account numbers.
2) Completed supplier W-9 (we have the signed copy Rafael attached).
3) Supplier legal name and address (as it should appear on the PO).
4) If your AP team requires a supplier questionnaire, please flag any fields that require Redwood-specific answers and we'll return them within 48 hours.

Couple of process notes:
- If Horizon creates the supplier request in Coupa, please provide the generated Supplier ID (S-#####). We will validate the ID and confirm our internal vendor code.
- For higher-value customers we run vendor verification checks; this usually adds 1 business day.

I've also included a DocuSign link for the bank authorization form (if you prefer e-sign). DocuSign: https://docusign.com/sup/abc123

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
